name: Juice Delivery
summary: In Darkshire, a potent brew draws raised eyebrows as you carry it west. Tavernkeep Smitts entrusts you with Zombie Juice for Abercrombie, a reclusive hermit on Duskwood’s western edge. The drink is meant to warm the shivering old man, but its uncanny potency raises questions.

sections.title: A Dubious Concoction
sections.body: Tavernkeep Smitts of Darkshire brews a legendary draught called Zombie Juice. When it is ready, he hands you the bottle and warns you to handle it gently, saying the concoction is stout enough to raise the dead. You carry the potent drink across a haunted forest to an eccentric loner, on what seems like a simple act of charity.

sections.title: The Hermit's Slip
sections.body: Abercrombie lives in a shack on the edge of the woods, where you bring him the volatile brew. The frail recluse claims he needs the liquor to warm his aching bones through Duskwood’s freezing, fog-choked nights. As he takes the bottle, Abercrombie nearly thanks you for your “foolishness,” then quickly corrects himself and praises your “kindness.” The slip hints that he has further plans for the brew beyond an evening drink.

faq.answer: Zombie Juice is an extremely potent brew made by Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. He says it is stout enough to wake the dead, far stronger than ordinary spirits.
Abercrombie, an eccentric old hermit in a lonely shack near Duskwood’s western boundary, requests the Zombie Juice.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie want the drink?
faq.answer: Abercrombie claims he needs the drink to keep warm during Duskwood’s bitterly cold, damp nights. When he receives it, his slip of the tongue hints at sinister designs for the concoction.
Tavernkeep Smitts, the barkeep who runs the Scarlet Raven Tavern in the heart of Darkshire, brews Zombie Juice himself once he has the pungent ingredients he needs.
Abercrombie’s isolated shack stands in western Duskwood, just north of Raven Hill Cemetery.

faq.q: What does Abercrombie do next after receiving the juice?
faq.answer: After securing the Zombie Juice, Abercrombie keeps imposing on gullible travelers. He sends them into Raven Hill Cemetery to gather ghoul ribs for a ghoulish effigy he claims will keep the undead away.

angles.text: As an Alliance courier, you brave Duskwood’s perilous roads for Darkshire’s citizens. Trusting every hermit in the woods can bring unforeseen trouble.
As a cook, you can see that Tavernkeep Smitts’ Zombie Juice recipe relies on pungent, unconventional ingredients and tests what belongs in a tavern beverage.
